patronOf.en-US: Priest and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May the true faith, which he excelled in teaching, always be our light and our strength.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que a verdadeira fé, por ele ensinada de modo excelente, seja sempre nossa luz e nossa força.

meta.face: A Levantine man of about sixty-five with a warm olive complexion and a long, narrow face — a high, lined forehead, a long, thin nose with a high bridge curving slightly at the tip, heavy-lidded, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under dark, gently sloping brows, lean cheeks under fine cheekbones, a narrow chin hidden in the beard and a small mouth; a long, wavy, iron-grey beard falling in soft strands to the breast and a grey moustache; a grave, gentle, contemplative gaze lowered to the scroll.
meta.basis: No likeness from life survives; the Athonite fresco on Wikipedia shows the Byzantine type: a long, lean face, a long wavy grey-white beard and the striped white head-cloth, writing on a scroll. The card keeps that type, iron-grey rather than white, with the olive complexion of a Damascene Arab and Mar Saba, where he lived and wrote.
